regions.chars: Theo and Clara met on a rainy September afternoon, sharing one umbrella and a pot of tea that went cold while they talked. Six years, two cities and one very patient dog later, he asked among the olive trees and she said yes. Now they cannot wait to begin the next chapter with the people they love most beside them.
